sentences.en: One day, in January 2017, a maintenance guy was doing his daily round at the Vienna airport.
sentences.zh: 2017年1月的一天，维也纳机场的一名维修工正在例行巡视。

sentences.en: He walks into a single-person bathroom.
sentences.zh: 他走进一间单人洗手间。

sentences.en: This is it.
sentences.zh: 就是这里。

sentences.en: And opens a small door on the back wall to access some pipes.
sentences.zh: 他打开后墙上的一扇小门去检查管道。

sentences.en: And inside...
sentences.zh: 而在里面……

sentences.en: That's where they found the gun.
sentences.zh: 他们就是在那儿找到了枪。

sentences.en: ...there's an old black pistol.
sentences.zh: ……有一把旧黑色手枪。

sentences.en: And it's loaded.
sentences.zh: 而且子弹上膛。

sentences.en: So he takes the gun to the police.
sentences.zh: 于是他把枪交给了警察。

sentences.en: And the police set a trap to see who comes to get it.
sentences.zh: 警察设下陷阱，看看是谁来取枪。

sentences.en: About two weeks later, someone does.
sentences.zh: 大约两周后，有人来了。

sentences.en: The man they arrest identifies himself as an officer in the German military.
sentences.zh: 他们逮捕的那名男子自称是一名德国军官。

sentences.en: And after hours of questioning, they let him go.
sentences.zh: 经过几个小时的盘问，他们放了他。

sentences.en: When they run his fingerprints for a routine check, they come up with a match.
sentences.zh: 当他们例行核对他的指纹时，发现了一个匹配项。

sentences.en: But these fingerprints are not registered to a military officer.
sentences.zh: 但这些指纹并没有在任何军官名下注册。

sentences.en: They're registered to a Syrian refugee.
sentences.zh: 它们登记在一个叙利亚难民名下。

sentences.en: This sets off alarm bells and an investigation that eventually spans three countries and multiple intelligence agencies.
sentences.zh: 这拉响了警报，并引发了一项最终跨越三个国家、涉及多个情报机构的调查。

sentences.en: And what they find is that in 2015, as hundreds of thousands of refugees were arriving in Germany,
sentences.zh: 他们发现，在2015年成千上万的难民涌入德国期间，

sentences.en: this German military officer disguised himself and managed to fool the authorities into believing he was one of those refugees.
sentences.zh: 这名德国军官伪装自己，成功欺骗了当局，让人相信他是那些难民之一。

sentences.en: For over a year, he had been living a double life.
sentences.zh: 一年多来，他一直过着双重生活。

sentences.en: The question was, why?
sentences.zh: 问题是，为什么？

sentences.en: So they arrest him again.
sentences.zh: 于是他们再次逮捕了他。

sentences.en: And in a series of raids, they find stolen ammunition, a copy of Hitler's Mein Kampf, and a notebook with the names of liberal politicians and activists.
sentences.zh: 在一系列搜查中，他们找到了被盗的弹药、一本希特勒的《我的奋斗》，以及一本写有自由派政客和活动人士名字的笔记本。

sentences.en: And they start to piece together a story that he'd been planning an attack, that was meant to be blamed on his fake refugee identity, spark a national backlash against refugees,
sentences.zh: 他们开始拼凑出一个故事：他一直在策划一场袭击，并打算嫁祸于他伪造的难民身份，从而引发全国对难民的反弹，

sentences.en: and trigger enough civil unrest to ultimately bring down the Federal Republic of Germany.
sentences.zh: 并触发足够的民间骚乱，最终颠覆德意志联邦共和国。

sentences.en: He denies this.
sentences.zh: 他对此予以否认。

sentences.en: But the story about this military officer,
sentences.zh: 但关于这名军官的故事——

sentences.en: known publicly as Franco A., catches fire in the press.
sentences.zh: 公众称他为弗兰科·A（Franco A.）——在媒体上引发了轩然大波。

sentences.en: Authorities say the suspect was conspiring to assassinate top politicians and then put the blame on refugees.
sentences.zh: 当局表示，嫌疑人曾密谋暗杀高层政客，然后将罪责推给难民。

sentences.en: And the military panics.
sentences.zh: 军方陷入了恐慌。

sentences.en: Investigators found now parts of a gun engraved with a swastika.
sentences.zh: 调查人员现在发现了一把刻有卐字标志的枪支零件。

sentences.en: They start searching barracks for evidence of far-right extremism.
sentences.zh: 他们开始搜查军营，寻找极右翼极端主义的证据。

sentences.en: Soldiers at several barracks were caught with World War II German army memorabilia.
sentences.zh: 几个军营的士兵被发现藏有二战德国军队的纪念品。

sentences.en: And they find plenty.
sentences.zh: 而且他们找到了很多。

sentences.en: 41 items of memorabilia were found.
sentences.zh: 共发现了41件纪念品。

sentences.en: The defense minister publicly states that the German military has a problem.
sentences.zh: 国防部长公开表示，德国军队存在问题。

sentences.en: They have looked into almost 300 soldiers with possible neo-Nazi views.
sentences.zh: 他们已经调查了近300名可能有新纳粹观点的士兵。

sentences.en: It's a problem that has only grown more urgent.
sentences.zh: 这个问题变得越来越紧迫。

sentences.en: The Capitol riots of January 6th put a spotlight on military extremism.
sentences.zh: 1月6日的国会山骚乱将人们的目光聚焦于军队极端主义。

sentences.en: And not just in Germany.
sentences.zh: 不仅在德国。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: military says it is taking action to address extremism within their ranks.
sentences.zh: 军方表示正在采取行动解决其队伍中的极端主义问题。

sentences.en: The Pentagon says the deadly riot at the U.S.
sentences.zh: 五角大楼表示，美国

sentences.en: Capitol was a wake-up call.
sentences.zh: 国会山的致命骚乱是一个警钟。

sentences.en: Ordering a service-wide standout.
sentences.zh: 下令全军停训整顿。

sentences.en: Stand down to admit they had a problem.
sentences.zh: 停训以承认他们存在问题。

sentences.en: Never has this been more important than now, as we face potential threats from within.
sentences.zh: 在我们面临来自内部的潜在威胁之际，这一点从未像现在这样重要。

sentences.en: The story that started with a German military officer and a gun in an airport bathroom, and that is still unfolding all these years later,
sentences.zh: 这个以德国军官和机场洗手间里的一把枪开始、并在多年后的今天仍在继续发展的故事，

sentences.en: is raising a question that democracies across the world are waking up to.
sentences.zh: 提出了一个世界各地民主国家正在觉醒并面对的问题。

sentences.en: What happens if the threat is coming from within?
sentences.zh: 如果威胁来自内部，会发生什么？

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Katrin Benholdt.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的卡特琳·本霍尔德。

sentences.en: This is Day X.
sentences.zh: 这是《X日》。

sentences.zh: 那我可以直接走吗？

sentences.en: You tell me.
sentences.zh: 你说了算。

sentences.zh: 对，你直接走就行。

sentences.en: When I first heard the story of Franco A., I was in London, covering a string of Islamist terrorist attacks.
sentences.zh: 当我第一次听到弗兰科·A的故事时，我正在伦敦报道一系列伊斯兰恐怖袭击。

sentences.en: And I remember thinking, how bizarre and sinister it all seemed.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时想，这一切是多么诡异和险恶。

sentences.en: A military officer dressing up as a Syrian refugee to assassinate someone in the hopes of bringing down the government.
sentences.zh: 一名军官伪装成叙利亚难民去暗杀某人，企图借此颠覆政府。

sentences.en: And then, over a year later,
sentences.zh: 然后，一年多以后，

sentences.en: after I was posted to Berlin,
sentences.zh: 在我被派驻柏林之后，

sentences.en: the story took another turn.
sentences.zh: 这个故事发生了另一个转折。

sentences.en: Reports started saying that Franco A.
sentences.zh: 有报道称，弗兰科·A

sentences.en: was part of a nationwide far-right network.
sentences.zh: 是一个全国性极右翼网络的一部分。

sentences.en: With dozens of soldiers and police officers, all organized on encrypted telegram chats.
sentences.zh: 拥有数十名士兵和警察，全部通过加密的电报（Telegram）聊天群组织起来。

sentences.en: Some even call this network a shadow army.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至称这个网络为影子军队。

sentences.en: That really stopped me.
sentences.zh: 这真的让我停了下来。

sentences.en: Because in Germany, shadow army evokes history.
sentences.zh: 因为在德国，“影子军队”唤起了历史的回忆。

sentences.en: In the decade before Hitler came to power,
sentences.zh: 在希特勒上台前的十年里，

sentences.en: far-right paramilitary groups plotted coups,
sentences.zh: 极右翼准军事组织策划政变，

sentences.en: assassinated politicians, and eventually supported the rise of the Nazis
sentences.zh: 暗杀政客，并最终支持了纳粹的崛起

sentences.en: and the death of democracy.
sentences.zh: 以及民主的消亡。

sentences.en: So in March 2019,
sentences.zh: 所以在2019年3月，

sentences.en: I called the Defense Ministry to get some hard numbers of how many far-right extremists had been identified in the military.
sentences.zh: 我打电话给国防部，想获取关于军中究竟识别出了多少名极右翼极端分子的确切数字。

sentences.en: The senior official I talked to told me that the number was small and falling.
sentences.zh: 我交谈的高级官员告诉我，这个数字很小而且在下降。

sentences.en: The most recent figure he had was four.
sentences.zh: 他掌握的最新数字是四个。

sentences.en: Four soldiers who had been confirmed as far-right extremists in the entire military.
sentences.zh: 整个军队中被确认有极右翼极端主义观点的士兵只有四名。

sentences.en: And when I asked about Franco A.
sentences.zh: 当我问及弗兰科·A

sentences.en: and the network he was allegedly a part of, he said, we don't see any networks.
sentences.zh: 以及他据称参与的网络时，他说，我们没有看到任何网络。

sentences.en: The whole thing just didn't add up.
sentences.zh: 整件事情根本说不通。

sentences.en: It seemed like they were either misunderstanding the problem
sentences.zh: 看起来他们要么是误解了这个问题，

sentences.en: or they were willfully blind to it.
sentences.zh: 要么就是对此视而不见。

sentences.zh: 我很快了解到，议会中负责情报监督的委员会也在调查此事。

sentences.zh: 关于这把枪，有一点很有意思。

sentences.en: I read several police interviews with soldiers and it's clear that some sort of network exists.
sentences.zh: 我阅读了几份警方对士兵的审讯记录，很明显某种网络确实存在。

sentences.en: They're connecting on telegram.

sentences.en: They're meeting in person and at least two of the administrators including the guy who started it all were soldiers of Germany's most elite military unit the KSK.
sentences.zh: 他们举行线下会面，其中至少两名管理员（包括始作俑者）是德国最精锐的特种部队 KSK 的士兵。

sentences.en: Basically

sentences.zh: 所以我联系了 KSK，经过多次请求，我获得了该部队指挥官的采访机会。

sentences.zh: 他说他耽误了，因为他花了过去四个小时盘问他手下的一个士兵，关于一个有半打

sentences.zh: 纳粹礼的聚会。

sentences.en: This is part of a problem he openly acknowledges.
sentences.zh: 这是他公开承认的问题的一部分。

sentences.zh: 他承认 KSK 比其他部队面临更严重的极端主义困扰。

sentences.en: And when I ask him if there really is a shadow army he tells me he doesn't know but it worries him

sentences.en: not just as the head of the special forces but also as a citizen.
